usdRate.sourceName: Banco de Moçambique, reference exchange rates bulletin 170/02/26 (4 September 2026)
usdRate.note: Mid rate 63.91 meticais per dollar (buy 63.27, sell 64.54); the latest official bulletin that could be read.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: INE Moçambique CPI, September 2026, via Trading Economics
inflation_cpi.note: Year-on-year inflation 6.31% in September 2026, down from 6.45% in August and 7.51% in June (fuel price shock in May); secondary source as the INE release was not reachable.

inflation_projection.sourceName: Banco de Moçambique aims for single-digit inflation; 2021-2025 CPI average about 6%
inflation_projection.note: No numeric target is published; the 2021-2025 average of about 6% (World Bank) matches the 2026 level, so 6% is used.

policy_rate.sourceName: Banco de Moçambique, MIMO policy rate unchanged at 9.25% (30 September 2026)
policy_rate.note: MIMO rate held at 9.25% since the cut from 9.50% on 28 January 2026; standing deposit facility 6.25%, lending facility 12.25% (Diário dos Mercados, July 2026).

savings_account_rate.note: The Banco de Moçambique publishes only the 1-year deposit and loan rates on balances; no savings account rate was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No published 3-month term deposit rate was found in Banco de Moçambique statistics.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Banco de Moçambique, Resumo Mensal de Informação Estatística (June 2026 issue), Quadro 4 (average nominal 1-year deposit rate on balances)
fdr_1y_rate.note: Average 1-year deposit rate 4.34% in May 2026, down from 6.60% a year earlier as the policy rate was cut.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product or rate was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST), Mozambique
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Average for 2025 (5.77%); the Banco de Moçambique 1-year deposit rate fell to 4.34% by May 2026.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate for individuals was found; individuals can subscribe to Treasury bonds (Obrigações do Tesouro) through the stock exchange.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Banco de Moçambique, Diário dos Mercados, 26 August 2026, type A Treasury bill auctions
tbill_91d_rate.note: 91-day weighted average 12.15% (182-day 12.22%, 364-day 12.15%); the latest daily bulletin that could be read.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Forbes Africa Lusófona (Lusa), Treasury bond exchange operations 2026
tbond_5y_rate.note: Secondary source: the latest Treasury bonds (OT 2026 series, maturing September 2032, about 6 years) carry a fixed 13.25% coupon, as did the 3-year OT-2026-S2 (April 2026); no exact 5-year yield was published.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year domestic Treasury bond issue or yield was found for 2025-2026; recent issues run 3 to 6 years.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Mozambique, individual income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest from bank deposits and income from debt bonds is withheld at 10% (other capital income 20%); secondary source.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: There is no government savings certificate; income from debt bonds is withheld at 10% (PwC).

deposit_insurance_limit.note: A deposit guarantee fund (Fundo de Garantia de Depósitos) exists, but its cover limit per depositor could not be read from an official source; its website was unreachable and the search budget ran out.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap was found; credit is priced off the prime rate (15.50% in May 2026, BdM Resumo Mensal June 2026) plus a bank spread.

equity_return_low.sourceName: No liquid local equity index (Bolsa de Valores de Moçambique is small); global equities in metical terms
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a weak decade for global shares with a stable metical.

equity_return_base.sourceName: No liquid local equity index (Bolsa de Valores de Moçambique is small); global equities in metical terms
equity_return_base.note: With no liquid local index, equity means global shares in metical terms: about 7% in dollars plus about 2% a year of metical depreciation, below the roughly 11% after-tax bill rate.

equity_return_high.sourceName: No liquid local equity index (Bolsa de Valores de Moçambique is small); global equities in metical terms
equity_return_high.note: High case: strong global markets plus faster metical depreciation.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; metical about 63.9 per dollar (BdM, September 2026), stable since 2021 after large falls in 2016-2017
gold_return_low.note: Low case: flat dollar gold prices with a stable metical.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; metical about 63.9 per dollar (BdM, September 2026), stable since 2021 after large falls in 2016-2017
gold_return_base.note: Base case: a long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% plus about 3% a year of metical depreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: Gold trend in dollars; metical about 63.9 per dollar (BdM, September 2026), stable since 2021 after large falls in 2016-2017
gold_return_high.note: High case: strong gold years and a renewed metical slide.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: BdM: 1-year deposits 4.34% (May 2026), 91-day and 364-day bills about 12.2% (Aug 2026); 10% tax on deposit and bond interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: bank deposits only, at about 4.3% before the 10% tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: BdM: 1-year deposits 4.34% (May 2026), 91-day and 364-day bills about 12.2% (Aug 2026); 10% tax on deposit and bond interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of tax-paid deposits (3.9%) and Treasury bills and bonds (11-12% after tax), allowing for bill rates falling with the policy rate.

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: BdM: 1-year deposits 4.34% (May 2026), 91-day and 364-day bills about 12.2% (Aug 2026); 10% tax on deposit and bond interest (PwC)
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: Treasury bonds at 13.25% held to maturity, after the 10% tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The insurance supervisor ISSM publishes market bulletins, but no industry life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No regulator or official source publishing term life premiums per MT 1,000 of cover was found.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost of a private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or official source publishing private health insurance premiums by age was found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure), Mozambique
oop_health_share.note: 10.4% in 2023 (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database), the latest available; low because public care is nearly free and donors fund much of health spending. Older than 2025.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Inflation assumption 6%; private care and medicines largely imported
goal_inflation_health.note: No medical price projection was found; private medical costs are planned 1.5 points above general inflation.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Inflation assumption 6%; no education CPI projection found
goal_inflation_education.note: Private school and university fees are planned 1 point above general inflation.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN), Mozambique

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 (medium variant) for 2026; totals are the mean of men and women except at 65, where the page gives 12.7.

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: Working-age people per person 65+, computed as 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 5.15 in 2025 (World Bank) gives 19.4; 4.9 in 2040 and 8.2 in 2065 (populationpyramid.net/mozambique/2040/ and /2065/) give 20.4 and 12.2.

retirement_age_default.note: INSS old-age pension at 60 for men and 55 for women with 240 months of contributions (or any age with 420 months); 50% reduced pension with 120 months; no change for later birth cohorts was found. Secondary source summarising Decree 51/2017.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: AIM (Agência de Informação de Moçambique), parliament approves mandatory retirement at 65 in the civil service
retirement_age_government.note: Revision of the civil service statute (EGFAE) raising mandatory retirement from 60 to 65 for men and women, extendable to 70 for strategic careers (diplomats, lecturers, doctors, researchers); approved in general by parliament on 29 April 2026 per AIM. Final promulgation (reported as Law 10/2026) could not be confirmed from an official text. Secondary source.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: BdM: 1-year deposits 4.34% (May 2026), 91-day and 364-day bills about 12.2% (Aug 2026); 10% tax on deposit and bond interest (PwC)
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: bank deposits after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: BdM: 1-year deposits 4.34% (May 2026), 91-day and 364-day bills about 12.2% (Aug 2026); 10% tax on deposit and bond interest (PwC)
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: a mix of deposits and Treasury bills after tax, kept well below the roughly 11% after-tax bill rate because bill rates are expected to fall.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: BdM: 1-year deposits 4.34% (May 2026), 91-day and 364-day bills about 12.2% (Aug 2026); 10% tax on deposit and bond interest (PwC)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: mostly Treasury bills and bonds after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Safe mix about 7%; global equity base 9%; gold base 8%

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Safe mix about 7%; global equity base 9%; gold base 8%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: Treasury securities and deposits with some foreign equity and gold.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Safe mix about 7%; global equity base 9%; gold base 8%

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The Programa Subsídio Social Básico (INAS) is a poverty-targeted household transfer for older people unable to work, not a pension anyone can plan on: amounts (reported at 540 MT for a one-person household since 2018) are not published officially and only about 5% of its 2024 budget was paid (CIP report, July 2025).

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: PSSB eligibility is poverty-targeted; the 2004 regulation set 55 for women and 60 for men, while later studies describe 60 for both, so current official ages could not be confirmed.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory retirement gratuity was found; Labour Law 13/2023 (art. 141) gives dismissal compensation in days of pay per year of service by salary band (30 days up to 7 minimum wages per secondary sources), which is not paid on retirement.

public_pension_scheme.note: INSS compulsory scheme for employees (voluntary for the self-employed): pension from 60 (men) or 55 (women) after 240 months of contributions, floor 90% of the lowest minimum wage. No automatic indexation was found (pensioners were demanding adjustments in December 2025, AIM), so inflationLinked is false; tax treatment not found.

savings_account.note: Offered by banks; interest is withheld at 10%.

fdr_3m.note: Offered by banks; no published average rate.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No government savings certificate for individuals; retail investors can buy Treasury bonds instead.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the Banco de Moçambique; companies and individuals held about MT 10.9 billion of bills on 26 August 2026.

tbond_5y.note: Treasury bonds are issued and listed through the stock exchange (BVM); recent issues run 3 to 6 years at 13.25%. Retail access is through banks and brokers registered with the BVM.

tbond_10y.note: No 10-year domestic Treasury bond issue was found for 2025-2026.

equity_fund.note: The stock exchange is small and no diversified retail equity fund was found.

gold.note: No retail channel for investment gold bars or coins was found; gold is bought mainly as jewellery.

insuranceRegulator.name: Instituto de Supervisão de Seguros de Moçambique (ISSM)

insuranceComplaints.name: ISSM consumer service portal (Portal de Atendimento ao Consumidor)

oldAgeAllowance.name: Instituto Nacional de Acção Social (INAS), Programa Subsídio Social Básico
oldAgeAllowance.note: Poverty-targeted transfer for older people and others unable to work.

publicHealthCover.name: Ministério da Saúde (national health service)
publicHealthCover.note: Public care is free or charged at nominal fees.
